title: Calculate Digit Sum of a String
summary: Given a string s of digits and an integer k, repeatedly divide s into groups of k digits, sum the digits in each group, and replace the group with the sum.
statement: Given a string s of digits and an integer k, repeatedly divide s into groups of k digits, sum the digits in each group, and replace the group with the sum. Continue this process until the string length is less than or equal to k, then return the modified string.
constraints: s contains digits and k is at least two.
While len(s)>k, partition from the left into consecutive groups of at most k digits.
Replace each group by its decimal digit sum and concatenate the sums.
hints: Each transformation is a direct left-to-right grouping pass.
Convert each group’s characters to integers, sum them, stringify the result, and concatenate.
Repeat full passes only while the current length exceeds k.
A pass constructs exactly the specified replacement string; length decreases until the stopping condition is reached.
editorial: A pass constructs exactly the specified replacement string; length decreases until the stopping condition is reached.

tests.explanation: The first grouping gives 3465; grouping that result gives 135.
Every group sum is zero, so repeated transformation returns 000.
